0022600119.text: The Charlotte Hornets, 1-1 and 3rd in the Southeast, host the Washington Wizards, also 1-1 and 2nd in the Southeast, in the Hornets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, and both teams enter having lost their most recent game. Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Washington is without AJ Dybantsa, Jamir Watkins and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte won all four games against Washington in 2025-26, most recently a 129-112 road win on February 22.
